verdict.rationale: Floot's docs explicitly describe OAuth-based social sign-in ('Sign in with Google or Microsoft through OAuth that Floot brokers for you') and its AI-driven scaffolding ('Describe the integration you want... endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you'), which covers the social-login and scaffolding parts of the story. However, there is no explicit documentation of email/password sign-up-login flows being generated, nor independent confirmation of a full auth scaffold. Missing for 10: explicit email/password auth scaffolding documentation, more social providers beyond Google/Microsoft, and third-party/hands-on verification of the auth flow.
